REVANTH YALLANUR

Bengaluru, India | 6302050083 | revanthyallanur@gmail.com | LinkedIn: revanthyallanur

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Workfront Automation Specialist with 3+ years of experience in Adobe Workfront, Workfront Fusion, and Power BI. Expertise in building scalable automation workflows, system integrations, and executive dashboards. Proven ability to optimize enterprise operations, support clients, and deliver high-impact workflow solutions.

CORE SKILLS

Adobe Workfront, Workfront Fusion, Power BI (DAX, Data Modeling), SQL, Advanced Excel, ServiceNow, BigPanda, Azure, VMware

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Tata Consultancy Services (TCS), Bengaluru

Systems Engineer | Feb 2022 – Present

Designed and implemented Workfront custom forms and calculated fields to streamline request intake and approvals.  Built and administered request queues, routing rules, dashboards, reports, and layout templates for multiple teams.  Developed advanced Workfront Fusion scenarios automating document uploads, task completion workflows, and metadata capture. Integrated Workfront with JIRA and Bynder DAM to enable seamless ticketing and asset synchronization. Implemented robust error handling, routers, webhooks, and notifications to ensure automation reliability.

  Automated PTO submissions and dynamic user profile updates using Workfront Fusion.  Managed Fusion development and production environments and migrated scenarios using blueprint export/import.  Created Power BI dashboards to track KPIs, compliance metrics, and operational performance.  Resolved ServiceNow tickets within SLA, enhanced BigPanda alerting, and handled client escalations.  Performed testing, documentation, and mentored junior team members on improved workflows.

CERTIFICATIONS

Adobe Workfront Core Development (In Progress) ITIL Foundation Certification SQL Certification – QSpiders Software Security Assurance – Hitech VMware Certification BPS: Environment Health and Safety Foundation

EDUCATION

Bachelor of Engineering (Electrical & Electronics Engineering) R.N.S Institute of Technology, Bengaluru | Aug 2017 – Jun 2021

LANGUAGES

Telugu (Native) | English (Professional) | Kannada | Hindi
